caller_tactics.text: Hello, good afternoon! Am I speaking with Eszter?
Wonderful. I'm calling because we have a really quick Black Friday offer for you.
Only for these two days, we have a really good investment idea, and it offers you a very safe return.
That's not so important right now. What matters is that the window is short.
We are a small team that works with selected clients. Most people who hear about it get in straight away.
I understand, but you would be kicking yourself if you waited until next week.
I can explain everything on the phone, it's very simple, you don't need any paperwork for this.
